title: Lautaro ties Agüero: 41 Argentina goals, third all-time
caption:
Lautaro Martínez scored his 41st goal for Argentina, per Inter.it — level with Sergio Agüero, third on the all-time list. Separately, Gazzetta dello Sport reports a new deal for Carlos Augusto is a priority. Free daily digest of the Italian Inter press, in English: https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/tt/?ed=30
